The NORC Data Enclave® Gov is a data management platform that enables our public and private sector clients to share confidential data sets with research communities in pursuit of evidence-based discovery. The Data Enclave Gov is delivered as a PaaS using a multi-tenant hybrid cloud environment. 

Empowering Collaborative Research 

The scalable, high-performance virtual environment provides research teams with access to database, statistical, analytical, visualization, and reporting tools within an analytics platform. Specially designed for research work, the Data Enclave Gov balances security, privacy, and utility to optimize collaboration and support meaningful outcomes.

Driving Value

For our clients, the Data Enclave Gov offers a sound, efficient, flexible, and reliable data-sharing solution built with clear processes and strict standards for access and operations. Our secure data management platform can be tailored to adhere to regulatory frameworks, including CIPSEA, HIPAA, FERPA, COPPA, SOPPA, and others.

Who We Serve

The Data Enclave Gov is a research-ready solution for federal and state agencies, academic institutions, nonprofit organizations, foundations, and commercial entities.

NORC at the University of Chicago

The NORC Data Enclave Gov is developed, distributed, and maintained by NORC at the University of Chicago, an objective, nonpartisan research organization that delivers insights and analysis decision-makers trust.
